name: print-social-charcoal-and-lime-hiring-story-with-glass-role-list
title: Charcoal and lime 'We Are Hiring!' story with megaphones and a frosted role list
whatItIs: A vertical charcoal story with a lime and white headline (lime 'HIRING!' and 'CREATIVE', 'Professional' in a lime box), two black-and-lime megaphones, a frosted glass panel with 'Open Positions' and role bars, a lime 'Apply now' button, WhatsApp number and a solid lime footer band.
whatItMeans: Bold and modern; lime on charcoal feels electric and tech-savvy.
techniques: Box one word of the headline in the accent colour.
End the story with a solid accent footer band.
Frame roles in a frosted panel between props.

vocabulary.definition: A solid strip closing the layout.
